claims.claim: Collecting passports for an age decision creates a database of passport information.
A database created by collecting passports has liability and potential harm from compromise that exceed those associated with making an adult-or-minor decision.
Collecting identity documents is not the only safe option for age assurance.
Operating systems or account stores can provide an age signal usable for age assurance.
Credentials suitable for age assurance can be evaluated locally.
Third-party age-assurance tokens can return only an age band while keeping the underlying evidence from the app developer.
Turning an age check into a reusable identity layer makes the resulting data store an attractive target for misuse or attack.
Applicable legal rules or platform policies may prescribe age-assurance methods, evidence, audits, or fallback handling.
